### S3. Power analysis

The pre-registered power analysis (see `notebooks/02-power-analysis.qmd`
for full details) estimated a minimum detectable effect of
~25--30~min/decade at 80~\% power for the full record
($\kappa \approx 2.5$). Seasonal sub-analyses require effects
>45--60~min/decade to achieve the same power.

![Power curves for the full record, single-season, and half-season
  sample sizes at the observed concentration
  $\kappa \approx 2.5$.](results/figures/power_curve.pdf)

![Sensitivity of detection power to the concentration parameter
  $\kappa$.](results/figures/power_curve_kappa_sensitivity.pdf)

### S4. Supplementary analysis: temperature-weighted regression

Temperature-weighted von Mises regression (weight = diurnal amplitude)
yielded [beta_w]~h/decade~ (95~\% CI: [ci_w]), consistent with the
unweighted primary estimate.
